summary: 0-zeny Novice loop: farm prt_fild08 (Poring/Drops/Lunatic/Pupa), sell loot at Prontera tool/weapon NPCs, buy Knife [3] 1201 for 50z, reach Novice Job 10 + Basic Skill 9, pick a first class.

stat_progression.leftover_into: hold unspent points; they carry over to first class. Melee starters may swap INT->VIT, casters STR->INT (INT 9).

skill_order.why: Mandatory gate for every first-class change (rathena/npc/pre-re/jobs/1-1 scripts check it). 1 pt per job level 1-9.
+5 HP for 3 SP; marginal but free.

equipment_order.name: Knife [3]
equipment_order.why: First weapon purchase (prt_in Weapon Dealer loop); ATK 17.

equipment_order.name: Red Potion
equipment_order.why: Buy only a few; sell-loot funds them.

mobs.name: Poring
mobs.notes: Passive Looter, Water 1, drops Jellopy 70% (sell 3z), Sticky Mucus 4% (35z), Apple 10%

mobs.name: Pupa
mobs.notes: Immobile, Earth 1, Chrysalis 55%, Safe target for Lv1 characters

do_not_waste: stat points beyond the cheap 10s/9s before job 10 (keep the pool for the real class build)
LUK (0.3% crit per point is worthless at this stage)
zeny on anything but Knife + a few Red Potions before the job change
renewal_differences: Novice-phase mechanics are identical pre-re/renewal (stat costs, Basic Skill, job change at Novice job 10). Current-iRO features the wiki page shows (Criatura Academy instant-job-change track, free novice gear, Novice Falchion reward on Swordman change) are renewal-era and absent on this db/pre-re server: the classic npc/pre-re job quests apply instead.
